title: Frame set
description: One sealed record of exactly which frame bundles a corpus version staged. A scenario pins its single hash. It holds no path or clock, so two stagings of one corpus version give one hash on any data root.

corpus_manifest_sha256.description: Seal of the corpus manifest, which binds this record to the version's membership and splits.

bundles.description: One line per stream and generated case of the corpus version.

manifest_sha256.description: Seal of this record. It is the hash a scenario pins.

stream_id.description: The stream, or the id of a generated case.

parent_stream_id.description: The stream a generated case derives from, or null for a stream.

bundle_sha256.description: Hash of the bundle's identity: its pixels, timing and source.

source_sha256.description: Hash of the source file's bytes. A generated case states its parent's.

source_manifest_sha256.description: Seal of the source record the bundle rests on. A generated case states its parent's.

x-rules.seal: manifest_sha256 is the lowercase SHA-256 of the record without that key, as JSON with sorted keys, ASCII escapes and no whitespace.
x-rules.order: bundles are in ascending stream_id order, and each stream_id appears once.
x-rules.membership: bundles name exactly the streams and generated cases of the corpus manifest that corpus_manifest_sha256 seals.
x-rules.parent: parent_stream_id is null for a stream. For a generated case it names a stream of this record, whose source_sha256 and source_manifest_sha256 the case repeats.
